Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound on a residential street in League City, Texas, when the vehicle struck the
front of a second sedan, operated by Driver 2, which was stopped and facing south. The impact was low in speed but
direct, with the front bumpers meeting nearly head-on. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and was
assessed at the scene; the nature of the collision and the forces involved appear consistent with the reported injury.
Driver 1 was the only occupant of the first vehicle, and a Passenger riding in Driver 2's vehicle reported no injury.
Responding offciers and the Passenger confirmed Driver 1 was present in the vehicle at the time of impact. Scene
photographs show damage to both front ends, though some areas of the daamge could not be definitively linked to
this collision and may require further inspection. No independent witnesses came forward. No prior damage to either
vehicle was known to the parties or observed at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy
covering the first vehicle.
